messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_no_dates>
Backend engineering across transactional services, most recently a
settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day. Previously worked on
payment reconciliation and inventory systems.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary below to match the posting requirement.

If years of experience are neither stated nor calculable, ask me for the
figure and tell me what it costs not to supply it.

response.text:
To revise your candidate summary to match the job posting requirement, I need to know how many years of backend engineering experience you have. The job posting specifically requires 8 years. 

Not supplying this information may cause your application to be overlooked or rejected by recruiters who filter candidates based on explicit experience requirements. Please provide the number of years of backend engineering experience you possess so I can update your summary accordingly.
